summary_en: This early phase 1 study tests the safety and side effects of dapagliflozin given before surgery in people with stage IA lung adenocarcinoma. Participants take dapagliflozin by mouth once a day for 30 days, as long as the disease does not get worse and side effects remain acceptable. The study measures safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase temprana 1 evalúa la seguridad y los efectos secundarios de la dapagliflozina administrada antes de la cirugía en personas con adenocarcinoma de pulmón en estadio IA. Los participantes toman dapagliflozina por vía oral una vez al día durante 30 días, siempre que la enfermedad no empeore y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Able to give written informed consent
Biopsy-confirmed stage IA lung adenocarcinoma, with tissue available for Ki-67 testing
Willing to have a research CT-guided lung biopsy
not_for: Current or past treatment with SGLT2 inhibitors
Other cancers not fully treated at least 2 years before registration, with exceptions
Regular systemic steroids above 10 mg prednisone daily or equivalent
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or unwilling to use birth control
